atlas-2.label: Ottoman national flag, 1844 design
atlas-2.attribution: User:Orwellianist; via Wikimedia Commons. Original SVG downloaded unchanged.
atlas-2.note: Five-pointed-star version; do not use for earlier Ottoman centuries. Annual display range ends with abolition of the sultanate in 1922.

atlas-15.label: Qing imperial flag, 1889 design
atlas-15.attribution: Original: zh:清朝政府 Vector: Sodacan; via Wikimedia Commons. Original SVG downloaded unchanged.
atlas-15.note: Rectangular Yellow Dragon flag. Do not use for Qing dates before 1889; earlier banners and the triangular maritime flag differ.

atlas-230.label: Soviet Union flag, 1936 design
atlas-230.attribution: created by rotemliss from Image:Flag of the Soviet Union.svg .; via Wikimedia Commons. Original SVG downloaded unchanged.
atlas-230.note: Period-specific reconstruction for the 1938 and 1945 snapshots; the 1955 redesign uses a separate asset.

atlas-230.label: Soviet Union flag, 1955 design
atlas-230.attribution: Cmapm; via Wikimedia Commons. Original SVG downloaded unchanged.
atlas-230.note: Dark-red rendering of the construction scheme adopted in 1955; appropriate to the 1960 snapshot. This entry stops before the 1980 revision.

atlas-29.label: Union Flag, 1801 design
atlas-29.attribution: Original: Acts of Union 1800 Vector: Zscout370; via Wikimedia Commons. Original SVG downloaded unchanged.
atlas-29.note: British metropolitan/Union flag, shown in its 1:2 maritime proportions. Colonial ensigns differed; this is not a distinct uniform flag for every imperial possession.

curated-french-colonial-empire.label: French tricolour, revolutionary design
curated-french-colonial-empire.attribution: Original: Unknown Vector: SKopp; via Wikimedia Commons. Original SVG downloaded unchanged.
curated-french-colonial-empire.note: Metropolitan national flag used during this imperial period, not an exclusive colonial flag. Omitted in the 1814–1830 restoration period; the brief 1815 return is not modeled at annual resolution.

curated-french-colonial-empire.label: French tricolour, restored in 1830
curated-french-colonial-empire.attribution: Original: Unknown Vector: SKopp; via Wikimedia Commons. Original SVG downloaded unchanged.
curated-french-colonial-empire.note: Restored in July 1830. Metropolitan flag representing this imperial umbrella; local colonial flags differed. Uses the darker-blue rendering before the 1974 shade change.

curated-french-colonial-empire.label: French tricolour, 1974 colour variant
curated-french-colonial-empire.attribution: This graphic was drawn by SKopp .; via Wikimedia Commons. Original SVG downloaded unchanged.
curated-french-colonial-empire.note: Lighter-blue rendering introduced in 1974; range is clipped to the dossier’s conventional 1980 endpoint.

atlas-16.label: Russian black–yellow–white state flag
atlas-16.attribution: Кёне, Бернгард Васильевич; via Wikimedia Commons. Original SVG downloaded unchanged.
atlas-16.note: State colours introduced in 1858. Conservative range ends before the 1883 order favouring the white–blue–red flag; black–yellow–white later retained dynastic uses.

atlas-16.label: Russian imperial national tricolour
atlas-16.attribution: Sports9494; via Wikimedia Commons. Original SVG downloaded unchanged.
atlas-16.note: White–blue–red was confirmed as the sole national flag in 1896. Earlier merchant and civil uses are not represented by this entry. Range ends with imperial government in 1917.

curated-portuguese-empire.label: Portuguese constitutional-monarchy flag
curated-portuguese-empire.attribution: Tonyjeff , based on ancient national symbol.; via Wikimedia Commons. Original SVG downloaded unchanged.
curated-portuguese-empire.note: Blue–white land flag adopted by the liberal regency in 1830 and used nationwide after 1834. The civil-war years and the 1910 transition are excluded conservatively.

curated-portuguese-empire.label: Portuguese republican national flag
curated-portuguese-empire.attribution: Original: Columbano Bordalo Pinheiro (1910; generic design) Vector: Vítor Luís Rodrigues; António Martins-Tuválkin (2004; this specific vector set: see sources); via Wikimedia Commons. Original SVG downloaded unchanged.
curated-portuguese-empire.note: Green–red republican flag sanctioned in 1911. It represents the metropolitan state in the remaining imperial period; it is not a separate colonial ensign.

atlas-11.label: Palaiologan imperial naval ensign (reconstruction)
atlas-11.attribution: Cplakidas This file was derived from: Byzantine imperial flag, 14th century (firesteels vesion).svg; via Wikimedia Commons. Original SVG downloaded unchanged.
atlas-11.note: Modern drawing of the tetragrammic-cross ensign attested in fourteenth-century sources, including Pseudo-Kodinos. Start c. 1350 reflects the attestation; it is not a universal Byzantine national flag.

curated-spanish-empire.label: Spanish naval ensign, 1785 design
curated-spanish-empire.attribution: previous version User:Ignaciogavira ; current version HansenBCN , designs from SanchoPanzaXXI; via Wikimedia Commons. Original SVG downloaded unchanged.
curated-spanish-empire.note: Red–yellow ensign adopted for the navy in 1785. This entry is explicitly naval; its later extension to the army dates to 1843.

curated-spanish-empire.label: Spanish monarchy flag, nineteenth-century design
curated-spanish-empire.attribution: previous version User:Ignaciogavira ; current version HansenBCN , designs from SanchoPanzaXXI; via Wikimedia Commons. Original SVG downloaded unchanged.
curated-spanish-empire.note: Red–yellow design extended to the army in 1843. Stops before the First Republic; it does not represent every earlier imperial banner.

curated-spanish-empire.label: Spanish monarchy flag, restored design
curated-spanish-empire.attribution: previous version User:Ignaciogavira ; current version HansenBCN , designs from SanchoPanzaXXI; via Wikimedia Commons. Original SVG downloaded unchanged.
curated-spanish-empire.note: Restoration-era crown-bearing version. Excludes the First and Second Republics and later Franco-era arms, which used different symbols.

atlas-24.label: Ethiopian imperial flag, Haile Selassie era
atlas-24.attribution: Oren neu dag; via Wikimedia Commons. Original SVG downloaded unchanged.
atlas-24.note: Lion of Judah imperial version. Restricted to the documented Haile Selassie-era rendering; does not claim a uniform nineteenth-century design.

atlas-24.label: Ethiopian imperial flag after restoration
atlas-24.attribution: Oren neu dag; via Wikimedia Commons. Original SVG downloaded unchanged.
atlas-24.note: Imperial flag after restoration in 1941. Excludes the Italian occupation of 1936–1940 and the 1974 regime transition.
